response.query: What objective criteria will select the 3–5 pilot firms (coverage thresholds, sector/policy exposure), and what power/simulation design will show detectable effect sizes?
response.answer: Objective criteria for pilot firms will include coverage thresholds and sector/policy exposure. Power/simulation design will use statistical methods to show detectable effect sizes.
